category_title: Students with ASD who initially engage through physical/sensory exploration and develop joint attention
scenario_title: Lack of effective communication during play
minimal_context: The student is in the school dinner hall playing 'throw and fetch' with a ball and the dog.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the ball. You can play throw and fetch with the dog.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes the ball and throws it, watching as the dog brings it back.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: He brought it back. Try again.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Repeats the sequence, throwing the ball again to see the dog's response.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What else can you do to play with the dog?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes attempts to get the dog's attention, but there is little effective communication. He suddenly switches off from the interaction and begins physical exploration of the dog's mouth and tongue instead.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is the ball. You can play throw and fetch with the dog.

STUDENT: (Takes the ball and throws it, watching as the dog brings it back.)

TUTOR: He brought it back. Try again.

STUDENT: (Repeats the sequence, throwing the ball again to see the dog's response.)

TUTOR: What else can you do to play with the dog?

STUDENT: (Makes attempts to get the dog's attention, but there is little effective communication. He suddenly switches off from the interaction and begins physical exploration of the dog's mouth and tongue instead.)

task.content: attempts by the student to get the dog’s attention

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: little effective communication between the dog and student, despite attempts by the student to get the dog’s attention
